extracted.intended_audience: researchers and reviewer-trainers (researchers at all career levels) and grant reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and templates for composing, assessing, and running collaborative peer reviews of research manuscripts (and related grant-review guidance), including bias-reflection, composition templates, live-review logistics, and an assessment rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Socially-conscious and constructive composition and assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: The Open Reviewers Toolkit ... to help guide the socially-conscious and constructive composition and assessment of research manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Toolkit framing: reviews should be socially conscious and constructive. Resources in the toolkit (Bias Reflection Guide, Reviewer Guide, Review Assessment Rubric) are intended to operationalize these values for reviewers and reviewers' trainers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bias Reflection Guide (self-assessment of reviewer bias)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bias Reflection Guide is a tool to help a reviewer assess their own biases, guiding them through a non-judgmental, self-reflective process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available in English (original), español, and português brasileiro. Intended as an explicit step for reviewers to surface and mitigate personal and structural biases before and during review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer Guide (comprehensive, step-by-step review framework)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Reviewer Guide is for anyone reviewing a research manuscript. It provides a comprehensive, step-by-step framework for the reviewer to use while they are composing a review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available in English (original), español, and português brasileiro. Serves as a template/checklist for content and structure of reviews to ensure thoroughness and constructive tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Assessment Rubric (10-statement evaluation of reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Review Assessment Rubric is for anyone evaluating a research manuscript’s review. The rubric comprises 10 statements for which the evaluator is asked to provide a score and a written comment to help improve the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available in English (original), español, and português brasileiro. Designed to assess the quality of peer reviews themselves (scoring + qualitative feedback) to support reviewer development and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical and constructive manuscript peer review (training objective)
rubrics_metrics.description: Open Reviewers Workshop ... a training designed for researchers at all career levels who are interested in engaging in ethical and constructive manuscript peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshop-derived standards emphasize ethics, constructiveness, and reviewer development; workshop materials (trainer guide, module slide decks, facilitation docs, assignments) provide concrete pedagogical practices for teaching these standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live Reviews: outputs must be actionable / integrable
rubrics_metrics.description: Live Reviews are topic-centered, interactive preprint review calls via a video conference tool such as Zoom. Outputs from Live Reviews can be used to improve a manuscript or be integrated into journal review workflows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Live Reviews should produce usable outputs (e.g., written notes, suggested edits, summaries) that authors or journals can act on; supporting materials include timeline, checklist, information document, registration text, email templates, communication plan, and full review composition template.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live Review Timeline & Checklist (process checklist for running Live Reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: Live Review Timeline & Checklist (in English and español).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete procedural checklist to plan and run Live Reviews (timing, roles, preparatory steps, follow-up). Used alongside registration forms and email templates to ensure consistent, equitable execution of Live Reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full Review Composition Template (structure for composing full reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full Review Composition Template (in English and español).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a recommended structure and prompts for composing a complete review suitable for reuse as preprint feedback or input to journal peer review; supports clarity, thoroughness, and actionability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative review facilitation and communications (templates & plans)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to run a collaborative Live Review; Collaborative Writing Guide Template; Communication Plan Template; Registration Form Text Template; Email Templates for Live Review Authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes planning, role assignment, inclusive facilitation, and clear communications. Templates help standardize invitations, registration, author communication, and collaborative writing expectations to promote equity and accessibility in group reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Reviewer Guide (framework for reviewing grant proposals)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Grant Reviewer Guide is a comprehensive, step-by-step framework designed to help anyone who is going through the process of reviewing a grant application proposal, whether directly invited to participate as an external reviewer, or selected through a call for reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Developed with funder partners to embed transparent, equitable, and inclusive practices into funding review. Materials focus on identifying and mitigating bias and assessing proposal quality and fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bias Reflection for grant review (assessors of grant proposals)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bias Reflection Guide is a tool for anyone tasked with evaluating the quality and fit of a grant proposal, either as an internal or external reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically recommended for grant reviewers as part of the Open & Equitable Model Funding Program; intended to prompt non-judgmental reflection on biases that could affect funding decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trainer and workshop materials for localized/region-specific reviewer training
rubrics_metrics.description: Open Reviewers in Africa: trainer guide, Module template slide decks, facilitation documents and assignment templates shared publicly in multiple languages to support a region-specific training program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use localized materials (language-specific trainer guides, slide decks, facilitation docs) to adapt peer-review training to regional contexts and to ensure cultural/linguistic accessibility when teaching review standards and practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: PREreview platform workflow & how-to (publication workflow & platform usage)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to use PREreview — A how-to-guide for using the PREreview.org platform; Full PREreview publication workflow; video demos and presentation templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the platform workflow and use provided demo/tutorial materials to publish, present, and share reviews in ways consistent with PREreview norms and the toolkit's standards (open licensing, attribution, and reuse).
